Package services

package services
Application services: persistence, authentication, course enrollment, marks, and messaging. Most services are singletons accessed via ServiceRegistry.
  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    AuthService
    Singleton authentication service: login, logout, and role checks.
    CourseService
    Course enrollment, teacher assignment, and registration request workflow.
    Database
    Singleton class representing the central data repository.
    Logger
    Simple file-backed application logger.
    MarkService
    Grading, transcripts, academic reports, and teacher ratings.
    MessageService
    Direct messages and complaints routed to managers or admins.
    NewsService
    Publishes and removes news items via the central Database.
    ResearchService
    Facade over research papers, projects, and supervisor assignment.
    ServiceRegistry
    Convenience accessors for all singleton application services.
    UserFactory
    Factory Design Pattern implementation for User creation.
    UserService
    CRUD operations for User instances backed by Database.
